name: regex-ai-mcp
description: MCP server for regular expression helper tools.

tools.name: build_regex
tools.description: Build common regex patterns. Types: email, url, phone, ipv4, date_iso, hex_color, credit_card, ssn, zip_us, uuid. Or describe a custom pattern.

tools.name: test_regex
tools.description: Test a regex pattern against a string. Flags: i(gnorecase), m(ultiline), s(dotall).

tools.name: explain_regex
tools.description: Explain a regex pattern in plain English.

tools.name: extract_matches
tools.description: Extract all matches of a pattern from text. group=0 for full match, 1+ for capture groups.
